'''Theresa''' (Japanese: '''タマミ''' ''Tamami'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP024|Cooking up a Sweet Story]]''. She works at a [[Sinnoh]] bakery café and is [[Abigail]]'s {{tt|niece|granddaughter in original Japanese version}}.

{{an|Dawn}} and {{Ash}} were having a practice battle when Theresa came along and commented on {{AP|Pikachu}}, wanting to borrow him for her grandmother. She explained that Abigail's {{p|Pikachu}}, [[nickname]]d Sugar, ran away. After a bit of convincing, Ash finally agreed, as it was only for a few days. Her substitute scheme initially worked and cheered Abigail up, but Abigail soon discovered that Pikachu wasn't her Sugar because of the way he collected the [[Aspear Berry|Aspear Berries]].

When {{TRT}} came and tried to kidnap Pikachu, both Theresa and Abigail chased after Team Rocket's mecha. She was just as surprised as anyone when Sugar came back, now evolved into a {{p|Raichu}}.
